newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Tech names deputy president.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Tech names deputy president.

text.p: Diversified industrial conglomerate Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp (STIC) said on Thursday Lye Fei would be the company's deputy president with effect from October 1.
Lye would concurrently hold the positions of chairman in Singapore Technologies Logistics Pte Ltd and deputy chairman in SAFE Enterprises Pte Ltd, the statement said.
The company said his role was to assist STIC's chief executive officer in overseeing the logistics and leisure businesses and developing the conglomerate's infrastructure.
Both Singapore Technologies Logistics and SAFE Enterprises are subsidiaries of STIC.
